steps.command: set -e; ip addr flush dev h1-eth0; ip addr flush dev h1-eth1; ip link set h1-eth0 down; ip link set h1-eth1 down; ip link add bond0 type bond mode active-backup miimon 100; ip link set h1-eth0 master bond0; ip link set h1-eth1 master bond0; ip link set h1-eth0 up; ip link set h1-eth1 up; ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev bond0; ip link set bond0 up
ip addr flush dev h2-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.0.2/24 dev h2-eth0; ip link set h2-eth0 up
ip -d link show bond0; ping -c 1 -W 2 -I bond0 10.0.0.2

set -e; active=$(ip -d link show bond0 | sed -n 's/.*active_slave \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p'); test -n "$active"; ip link set "$active" down; sleep 2; new=$(ip -d link show bond0 | sed -n 's/.*active_slave \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p'); test -n "$new"; test "$new" != "$active"; ping -c 1 -W 2 -I bond0 10.0.0.2
set -e; for p in h1-eth0 h1-eth1; do ip link set "$p" up; done; sleep 1; ping -c 1 -W 2 -I bond0 10.0.0.2
